correctness.rationale: For every \(n\ge9\), the exhaustive local-conflict table produces 120 finite states and 291 arcs. The exact listed 120-integer potential satisfies \(h(s)\ge h(t)+9w-7\) on all arcs, forcing \(|F|\le\lfloor7n/9\rfloor\) for every cyclic mask word. Explicit base words of lengths \(9\)–\(17\) have a common four-mask state and concatenate with the optimal nine-word to attain equality for every \(n\ge9\). For \(\(n=5\),\ldots,8\), an exact independent-set recurrence on each directly constructed edge-conflict graph gives 3,4,5,6 with witnesses. Reproduced verifier stdout and standalone code establish the finite premises; mathematical telescoping and concatenation establish infinitely many orders, not finite extrapolation. Residual risk: independent formal review has not been performed.

value.rationale: Determines exactly a natural edge extremal parameter of all connected cubic generalized Petersen graphs \(GP(n,2)\), a two-layer classical family, with sharp 7/9 density and an explicit nine-periodic construction. This improves known general cubic upper estimates, establishes both upper bound and witnesses for every order, and supplies a finite state/potential proof template for related periodic graph families. It does not claim an all-optima census or general-k case.
